description: This file defines a custom exception class 'AttendanceServiceException' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Attendance plugin. The class provides static methods to generate specific exception instances related to attendance management errors.

classes.name: AttendanceServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, providing static factory methods for specific attendance-related error conditions.

methods.name: punchOutAlreadyExist
methods.description: Returns an instance of AttendanceServiceException indicating a punch out attempt when the employee is already punched out.

methods.name: punchInAlreadyExist
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating a punch in attempt when the employee is already punched in.

methods.name: punchOutTimeBehindThanPunchInTime
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating that the punch out time is earlier than punch in time.

methods.name: punchInOverlapFound
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating an overlap found during punch in.

methods.name: punchOutOverlapFound
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating an overlap found during punch out.

methods.name: invalidDateTime
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating an invalid date or time was provided.

methods.name: punchOutDateTimeNull
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating punch out date/time is null.

methods.name: deletableAttendanceRecordIdsEmpty
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating no attendance record IDs found for deletion.

methods.name: invalidTimezoneDetails
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating invalid timezone information was provided.
